blocks.text: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump is asking Republicans to make November’s US midterm elections a referendum on him. A growing number of the party’s candidates appear intent on making their races about almost anything else. With Trump’s approval rating at a record low and Democrats opening a sizable lead on the congressional ballot, Republicans in competitive contests are increasingly putting daylight between themselves and the president — on immigration, the Iran war and even in the branding of their campaigns. A formerly loyal Florida representative last week released an ad warning Trump that his immigration crackdown had “gone too far” and […]...
